description:
Doors, walls and deployables ranked by sulfur to raid vs build cost. The data behind https://rust.wiki/building/best-value. `doors`, `walls` (walls, foundations and floors at
every grade) and `other` (raidable deployables), each hardest to raid first. Every row has `slug`, `name`,
`health`, `raid` - the cheapest single standard explosive (rockets, C4, satchel charges, explosive 5.56 ammo,
beancans) as `explosive` (shortname), `count` and `sulfur` - and `build`, resource name -> amount (a building
block's upgrade cost at its grade, a door's or deployable's crafting recipe). Building blocks add `grade` and
`type`; doors and deployables add `shortname`, `icon_url` and `url`. `explosives` names the shortnames. Raid
data cached for 24 hours.
name: get_best_defences
title: Doors, walls and deployables ranked by sulfur to raid vs build cost
